data_policy.evidence: Descriptions are visual observations, not manufacturer specifications. Image groups follow filenames and do not prove identical SKUs or sale bundles.
data_policy.unknown_values: null means unknown, not zero, free, unavailable, or unsupported. Empty sizes and available_colors lists mean unconfirmed, not no options.
data_policy.pricing: The merchant must provide price, currency, discount and any custom-design charges before a quote can be given.
data_policy.inventory: Photos do not establish current stock. Recheck availability before accepting payment.
data_policy.custom_design: A customer may submit a design request for review; acceptance, feasibility, price and lead time are not promised.
data_policy.images: Paths are local repository-relative file references, not hosted URLs. Upload or serve images and populate public_url before using them in a website or Messenger.
data_policy.care: Care and styling text is general guidance only. Follow the actual garment label and seller instructions.
data_policy.materials: Fiber composition, production method, brand authenticity, exact dimensions and colorfastness cannot be verified from these photos.

description.en: Green tunic-style top with a round neckline, short sleeves and a rectangular chest panel of yellow, reddish and green folk-inspired motifs. A hanging view and a folded detail view are provided.
description.bn: গোল গলা ও ছোট হাতার সবুজ টিউনিক ধরনের টপ। বুকের আয়তাকার প্যানেলে হলুদ, লালচে ও সবুজ লোকজ মোটিফ দেখা যায়। ঝোলানো ও ভাঁজ করা দুটি ছবি আছে।
description.banglish: Gol gola o chhoto hatar shobuj tunic dhoroner top. Buker ayotakar panel-e holud, lalche o shobuj lokoj motif dekha jay. Jholano o bhaj kora duti chhobi ache.

how_to_use.en: Wear as a tunic with suitable trousers or leggings; check chest and length measurements before ordering.

care.en: Check the care label; avoid rubbing or ironing directly over the decorated panel.
care.bn: কেয়ার লেবেল দেখুন; নকশার ওপর সরাসরি ঘষা বা ইস্ত্রি এড়িয়ে চলুন।
